author: everestmcarthur
install_msg:
Thanks for installing **New Help Menu v1.0.0** — the ultimate customisable help system!

The cog automatically replaces your default help command with an interactive, button-driven menu.

Get started:
• `[p]helpmenu theme <name>` — choose a theme (default, minimal, compact, dark)
• `[p]helpmenu category create <name> <emoji> <description>` — build custom categories
• `[p]helpmenu category addcog <category> <CogName>` — assign cogs to categories
• `[p]helpmenu settings` — view all current settings
• `[p]helpmenu preview` — preview the menu

Full docs: `[p]help helpmenu`
name: NewHelpMenu
short: Fully customisable interactive help menu with categories, buttons, select menus, themes, search & favourites.
description: New Help Menu v1.0.0 completely replaces Red's default help formatter with a modern, interactive experience. Features include: custom categories with emoji/colour/thumbnail/image per category, 4 built-in themes (default/minimal/compact/dark) plus full custom mode, button and select-menu navigation, paginated command lists, command search via modal, per-user favourite commands, role-gated category visibility, quick-link buttons (URLs), custom home page fields/images/tagline, per-command detail views with subcommand browsing, cooldown/permission/alias display toggles, DM help mode, ephemeral mode, auto-delete, hidden cogs/commands blacklists, uncategorised section control, and 50+ admin configuration commands.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs and guild IDs for per-user favourite commands and per-guild help menu configuration including categories, themes, and display preferences.
